capabilities: annotate whole paragraphs with a bracket marker and a margin note
highlight selected passages and attach a note to them
write, edit, and delete margin notes from a composer in Live Preview, Source mode, or Reading view
store annotations as standard Markdown footnotes that survive plugin removal
keep unsaved drafts locally when switching views or closing a note
extras: Not yet listed in the Community Plugins directory; installs via BRAT or manual download, with GitHub build-provenance attestations. Mobile is not yet verified. No account, payment, server, or network requests; unsaved drafts are stored locally in data.json and are not synced across devices.
intentEvidence: Disable the old Marginalia plugin before enabling Marginalia MD.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write anchored comments beside paragraphs or passages while keeping the note as plain, readable Markdown.

relations.evidence: Disable the old Marginalia plugin before enabling Marginalia MD.

summary: Margin annotation tool that adds paragraph and passage notes alongside your text and stores them as ordinary Markdown footnotes.
